title: The Allowance a Benefit Period Carries on a Card Coming Into Use
content:
The allowance a benefit period carries, for a Ridgecrest Healthy Options Card being brought into use, is taken from the medical plan the card hangs on where that plan is the more generous, and from the card's own tier otherwise.

**The rule.** The allowance a benefit period carries is the quarterly allowance the member's medical plan tier carries, where the card hangs on a medical plan that is in force and that plan's tier carries a quarterly allowance larger than the card's own; it is nothing, where the card hangs on a medical plan whose cover has ended, the allowance being a supplemental benefit of a medical plan; and it is the card's own tier quarterly allowance in every other case.

**Which records decide it.** The medical plan the card hangs on is the member's enrollment in the Medicare Advantage Health Plans. Whether it is in force is read from that enrollment's standing; the quarterly allowance its tier carries is a figure of that plan tier; and whether its cover has ended is read from the coverage end day carried on that enrollment.

| The member's Medicare Advantage Health Plans record | The allowance a benefit period carries |
|---|---|
| a plan in force whose tier carries a quarterly allowance larger than the card's own | the quarterly allowance that medical plan tier carries |
| a plan whose cover has ended | nothing |
| any other case | the card's own tier quarterly allowance |

**Worked through on hypothetical records.** A card whose tier carries a quarterly allowance of 135.00 USD, held alongside a medical plan in force whose tier carries 160.00 USD: the allowance a benefit period carries is 160.00 USD. The same card alongside a plan in force whose tier carries 100.00 USD: the plan's figure is not larger than the card's own, so it is 135.00 USD. The same card where the medical plan's cover has ended: it is nothing.
